name: geocoding
description: US ZIP code geocoding service — forward lookup, autocomplete and reverse geocoding

scripts.build: npm run build -w geocoding-server && npm run build -w geocoding-web
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:ingest
scripts.test: npm test -w geocoding-server && npm test -w geocoding-web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w geocoding-server && npm run test:integration -w geocoding-web
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
